final_wiki.Q-1222-answer:
Q-1222: Largest prime less than 679.

679 = 7 × 97 (composite).
678 = even (composite).
677: check divisibility by primes up to sqrt(677) ≈ 26 (2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23) — none divide 677.

Answer: 677
